names.note: Read out of the life doxologia.ro prints for 29 aprilie under the line «Sfinții 9 Mucenici din Cizic», which names the nine: «Teognid, Ruf, Antipatru, Teostih, Artema, Magn, Teodot, Tavmasie și Filimon».
Read out of saint.gr's heading on the page of «Άγιοι Εννέα Μάρτυρες εν Κυζίκω», «Άγιος Θεόστιχος Μάρτυρας Εν Κυζίκω», with the rank word and the place left off.

Read out of the body of the Охридски пролог's entry for 29. април ст. ст., out of the naming clause „Имена су њихова Теогоније, Руф, Антипатер, Теостих, Артем, Магн, Теодот, Тавмасије и Филимон.“ — a bare list with no rank word on any of them and no epithet; the heading names nobody, so there is no heading form to take, and Cyzicus, which this corpus's English name keeps, is in the heading and not in the list. The form meets nobody in any language, which was measured rather than assumed.

The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 2249, «Феостих Кизический, мч.», with the rank word after the comma left off. The day's own line declines the forename alone, so the toponymic — of Cyzicus — is read off the name link, where the calendar prints it. Measured against the gate's own key function before it was written: 'кизическии феостих' has no other holder in the corpus.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 апреля ст. ст. — «Девяти мучеников Кизических: Феогнида , Руфа , Антипатра , Феостиха , Артемы , Магна , Феодота , Фавмасия и Филимона (286-299).»

attestations.note: The day's first entry of eight, ONE LINE NAMING NINE MEN with a name link each and all nine pointing at one life page, and he is the fourth of them. ALL NINE ALREADY HAD FOLDERS, so this batch is nine upgrades and no arrival. THE LINE AND THE LIFE DISAGREE ABOUT THE YEAR: the line heads the nine «(286-299)» and life951 ends «усечены мечом (+ ок. 284 - 292)», and the `dates` written here are the union of the two, 284 to 299, because both are this source's own and the reader has no ground to prefer one. NO `locations` WERE WRITTEN although the city is named and placed — «Город Кизик находится в Малой Азии на берегу Дарданельского пролива» — because a located saint whose dates read as alive over a century fails `map-span.test.mjs` and this interval is fifteen years short of that limit; the city is in the life instead. TWO HYMNS were taken, the troparion and the kontakion the day page prints for the nine together, each copied whole with its tone and given the same English in this same batch; they name no one of the nine in particular, so each of the nine carries both. THE LIFE NAMES FOUR OTHER PEOPLE and none of them got a `related` row: «Константин Великий», under whom the persecutions stopped and the relics were taken up; «Юлиан Отступник», under whom the temples were rebuilt; a bishop «Елевсий» of Cyzicus whom Julian imprisoned; and the hierodeacon «Стефан» who carried part of the relics from Palestine to Kazan, with «святитель Димитрий Ростовский», who wrote their service. Sharing a page is not a relation, so all five are written in Cyrillic or by description in the life and none is linked. azbyka.ru was not read.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 29 aprilie — «Sfinții 9 Mucenici din Cizic»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 28ης Απριλίου — «Άγιοι Εννέα Μάρτυρες εν Κυζίκω»

attestations.note: The life page is one entry for all nine and heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 28 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing — **a day earlier than the 29 April the Romanian row on this folder already carries**, which is the Greek calendar's own reckoning of the same company and not a correction of it. It is plainly the same nine: the day's line is «Άγιοι Εννέα Μάρτυρες εν Κυζίκω», the page's own list names Theognis, Rufus, Antipater, Theostichus, Artemas, Magnus, Theodotus, Thaumasius and Philemon, and it has them from different places, seized together at Cyzicus, imprisoned without water or bread, and beheaded on the governor's order. The Greek adds an apolytikion of the nine, which the Romanian source did not print and which is stored here; it gives no year and no emperor, so this folder's empty `dates` were left empty, and it names no relic, where the Romanian life has the finding of the nine bodies under Constantine.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 12.05.2026 (29. април ст. ст.) — „Св. Девет мученика у Кизику.“

attestations.note: **The heading names nobody — „Св. Девет мученика у Кизику.“ counts them and stops — and the body is where this book names them**, so the citation above is that heading whole, per BRIEF-SERBIAN.md §4 and the coordinator's ruling for a heading that enumerates its members in the body. The body's own naming clause is „Имена су њихова Теогоније, Руф, Антипатер, Теостих, Артем, Магн, Теодот, Тавмасије и Филимон.“ — nine names, in the same order as doxologia's long life and as saint.gr's notice, with the same city, the same refusal, the same beheading and the same incorrupt relics, so they are the same nine. The form meets no other folder in any language. **A first date**: „Чесно пострадаше и прославише се у III веку“ → `death` 201–300, `display: "3rd century"`, `traditional`, where doxologia says only that it happened before Constantine's reign and saint.gr gives no year and names no emperor. `node .tmp/dd.mjs "3rd century"` reads «III в.» and «3ος αι.» New besides: that the church at Cyzicus was built **in the emperor Constantine's own time** and that the relics were laid in it — doxologia has the Christians of the city raise it after the persecution ceased, without putting it in the reign — and the sentence about despising the temporal for the eternal. The Prologue prints no hymn; saint.gr's apolytikion of the nine together was taken by neither reading.

hymns.text: Θείας πίστεως, τὴ συμφωνία, ἐννεάριθμος, Μαρτύρων δῆμος, ἐν Κυζίκῳ ἱερῶς ἠνδραγάθησε, τὸν γὰρ Ὑπέρθεον Λόγον κηρύξαντες, ὑπὲρ αὐτοῦ ὡς ἀμνοὶ σφαγιάζονται, ὅθεν ἄφεσιν, αἰτοῦνται ἠμὶν καὶ ἔλεος, τοὶς μέλπουσιν αὐτῶν τὴν θείαν ἄθλησιν.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος γ', Θείας πίστεως, on the page of «Άγιοι Εννέα Μάρτυρες εν Κυζίκω»

english.text: By the concord of divine faith the nine-numbered company of martyrs did valiantly and in holy fashion at Cyzicus; for having preached the supremely divine Word, they are slaughtered like lambs for His sake. Wherefore they ask forgiveness and mercy for us who sing their divine contest.

hymns.text: Святии девяточисленнии мученицы,/ от различных градов во един лик совокупившеся манием Божественным,/ мужественно за Христа пострадасте, невидимаго врага победисте,/ зловерныя князи и мучители посрамисте вашим терпением,/ огнем же любве Божия разжизаеми,/ вещественно вас огнь мучащий в хлад преложисте,/ темже дадеся вам от Христа Бога благодать трясавичную исцеляти болезнь,/ от неяже и многовидных страстей// милостивно спасайте и нас предстательством вашим, молимся.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, «Тропарь девяти мучеников Кизических», глас 8, under «Молитвы» on the day page for 29 апреля ст. ст. It is printed for the nine together and under no single name; the life page names Димитрий Ростовский as the author of their service.

english.text: O holy nine-numbered martyrs, gathered out of different cities into one choir at the beckoning of God, manfully did ye suffer for Christ and overcome the unseen enemy; by your patience ye put to shame the evil-believing princes and tormentors; and being kindled with the fire of the love of God, ye turned the material fire that tormented you into coolness. Wherefore there was given you of Christ God the grace to heal the shaking sickness: from it, and from passions of every kind, save us also in mercy by your intercession, we pray.

hymns.text: Твердый и всесветлый лик мученик девяти,/ Трисолнечнаго Божества исповедницы,/ на судищи Тому начально взываху:/ кровь и души наша с телесы,/ яко непорочную жертву, приносим Тебе, Владыко,/ в лицех Небесных Твоих сопричти,// яко Бог Милостивый.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, «Кондак девяти мучеников Кизических», глас 2, under «Молитвы» on the day page for 29 апреля ст. ст. It is printed for the nine together and under no single name.

english.text: The firm and all-radiant choir of nine martyrs, confessors of the Thrice-Sunlike Godhead, cried out to Him before all else at the judgement seat: our blood and our souls with our bodies we offer Thee, O Master, as an unblemished sacrifice; number us among Thy hosts in heaven, for Thou art a merciful God.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru's life page life951 ends the passion «Все девять мучеников были усечены мечом (+ ок. 284 - 292), и тела их погребли близ города», about 284 to 292; the day's own line heads the nine «(286-299)» instead. THE TWO DISAGREE AT BOTH ENDS and the interval recorded here is the union of them, 284 to 299, because each is this one source's own statement and neither was preferred over the other. The folder held no year of any kind before.
